question.leadin: Identify these people whose seats were contested in the 2012 elections.
question.text: This Maine Republican, one of the "Gang of 14," announced in February 2012 that she would retire at the end of her term because she was sick of partisanship. Her Senate seat was won by independent Angus King.
question.clue: This Greek Orthodox Maine Senator who served much of her career with Susan Collins was a member of the Gang of 14. In January, she retired in disgust over congressional partisanship and incompetence.

question.text: This woman wrote A Problem from Hell about American foreign policy on genocides in the 20th century. She was the U.S. Ambassador to the UN from 2013 to 2017.

swap.leadin: Answer questions about the doomed Equal Rights Amendment.
swap.text: This founder of the Eagle Forum campaigned to "Stop the Equal Rights Amendment" as it would eliminate nebulous "privileges" and force women into unisex bathrooms. Five states rescinded their ratifications after her anti-ERA campaign began. Her son Andrew runs the website Conservapedia.
